# Eyevinn Live Encoding (`eyevinn-live-encoding`)

Transform your live streaming with Eyevinn Live Encoding: Open-source, ffmpeg-based, and ready for HLS & MPEG-DASH. Streamline now, CDN-ready.

[Source](https://github.com/Eyevinn/live-encoding)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "eyevinn-live-encoding"
  name       = "myencoding"

  parameters = {
    # HlsOnly          = "true"
    # InputUrl         = "..."
    # InputDialTimeout = "..."
    # OutputUrl        = "..."
    # Ladder           = "..."
    # Framerate        = "..."
    # RateControl      = "..."
    # MaxrateFactor    = "..."
    # BufsizeFactor    = "..."
    # SegmentDuration  = "..."
    # SubtitleUrl      = "..."
    # SubtitleLanguage = "..."
    # SubtitleName     = "..."
    # SubtitleDefault  = "..."
    # SegmentType      = "..."
    # ProgramDateTime  = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    StreamKey = var.stream_key
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HlsOnly` | boolean | no | When enabled only output HLS Default `true`. |
| `StreamKey` | string | no | Configure encoder to push to rtmp://<host>/live/<StreamKey> Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `InputUrl` | string | no | URL endpoint for external service |
| `InputDialTimeout` | string | no | Timeout value in milliseconds or seconds |
| `OutputUrl` | string | no | If specified push to CDN origin |
| `Ladder` | string | no | Configuration option for ladder |
| `Framerate` | string | no | Configuration option for framerate |
| `RateControl` | string | no | Configuration option for ratecontrol |
| `MaxrateFactor` | string | no | Configuration option for maxratefactor |
| `BufsizeFactor` | string | no | Configuration option for bufsizefactor |
| `SegmentDuration` | string | no | Configuration option for segmentduration |
| `SubtitleUrl` | string | no | URL endpoint for external service |
| `SubtitleLanguage` | string | no | Configuration option for subtitlelanguage |
| `SubtitleName` | string | no | Configuration option for subtitlename |
| `SubtitleDefault` | string | no | Configuration option for subtitledefault |
| `SegmentType` | string | no | Configuration option for segmenttype |
| `ProgramDateTime` | string | no | Configuration option for programdatetime |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
